name: list_connectors
description: List all connectors for Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka Connect for a given project, location, and Connect cluster.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of connectors to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListConnectors` call.

parent.description: Required. The parent Connect cluster whose connectors are to be listed. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/connectClusters/{connect_cluster_id}
